title: Reuse a browser build
goal: Supply public WASM settings per environment; preserve provider precedence.

selectionNotes: WASM; environment follows JSON; remove duplicate registration.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical mode; no new syntax required.

prerequisites: Complete standalone project, pins, imports, document, startup JavaScript, JSON and local Node host are supplied below. Actual SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105/C# 15; interpreted publish uses PublishTrimmed=false, no wasm-tools/native compiler/AOT. Node 24.21.0 serves local fixtures only.

Load public settings before Blazor.start; configureRuntime.withEnvironmentVariables supplies browser runtime variables. Use Board__Endpoint for Board:Endpoint. Server OS variables do not automatically enter browser memory. No account, database or external endpoint is required.
constraints: WASM; environment-source precedence and removal of duplicate registration.

CreateDefault loads base JSON, environment JSON, then one environment provider. Later explicit providers win. Remove the old unprefixed AddEnvironmentVariables registration on .NET 11; keeping it after an override adds a second provider and can change the winner. Preserve intentional prefixed/custom providers with their explicitly tested order.

Every delivered setting is public and user-modifiable. Never send secrets, connection strings with credentials or authoritative permissions. Endpoints here are fictional public strings, not contacted services.

The .NET 10 manual provider is an actually compiled/executed comparison, not a target-10 route to automatic registration. Static SSR/Interactive Server do not use this browser provider; hosted/Auto apps need separate server/client configuration and are not executed here.

Choose exact case-sensitive environment JSON names, update external settings/cache policy coherently, and reload to apply startup values. This example has no hot reload or post-start environment mutation contract. A production host/CDN must preserve matching assets and public-settings delivery.
